en: The Kingdom of the South Saxons, today called the Kingdom of Sussex, as an early medieval English kingdom
Its territory roughly corresponding to the modern county of Sussex
zh: 萨塞克斯王国又称南撒克逊人的王国，是早期中世纪英格兰王国
领土大致相当于今萨塞克斯地区

politics.zh: 萨塞克斯王国又称南撒克逊人的王国，是早期中世纪英格兰王国，领土大致相当于今萨塞克斯地区，由埃勒及其后裔建立，是盎格鲁-撒克逊最早出现的王国之一。它在6至8世纪间与威塞克斯、肯特及麦西亚互动，多次被更强大的邻国支配；8世纪后逐步并入威塞克斯王国，此后作为郡与主教区延续。
politics.en: The Kingdom of the South Saxons, today referred to as the Kingdom of Sussex, was an early medieval English kingdom whose territory roughly corresponds to the modern county of Sussex, founded by Aelle and his descendants as one of the earliest Anglo-Saxon kingdoms. Through the sixth to eighth centuries it interacted with Wessex, Kent and Mercia and was repeatedly dominated by stronger neighbours; after the eighth century it was gradually absorbed into Wessex and continued afterwards as a shire and bishopric.

economy.zh: 经济以丘陵农业、沿海渔业与森林放牧为基础，海岸与河口提供航运便利，南唐斯丘陵的羊群与耕地是主要生计，与大陆的贸易经港口进行。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming on the downs, fishing along the coast and grazing in the forests, with its coast and estuaries making shipping easy, sheep and arable land on the South Downs the main livelihood, and trade with the continent passing through its harbours.

culture.zh: 萨塞克斯留下早期基督教与异教并存的考古证据，奇切斯特的教堂与罗马遗迹延续使用，地名与教区划分保留了王国时代的痕迹，南撒克逊人的谱系见于后世编年史。
culture.en: Sussex left archaeological evidence of early Christianity existing alongside pagan practice, the church and Roman remains at Chichester continuing in use, place names and parish boundaries preserving traces of the kingdom, and the genealogy of the South Saxons recorded in later chronicles.

events.zh: 关键节点包括5世纪末王国建立、6至7世纪与威塞克斯及肯特的互动、8世纪被麦西亚与威塞克斯支配，以及此后并入威塞克斯王国。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the kingdom at the end of the fifth century, its dealings with Wessex and Kent in the sixth and seventh, its domination by Mercia and Wessex in the eighth and its absorption into Wessex afterwards.

value.en: It was founded by Aelle and his descendants.

value.zh: 8世纪后逐步并入威塞克斯王国。
value.en: After the eighth century it was absorbed into Wessex.

en: The Icelandic Commonwealth, also called the Icelandic Free State, as the political unit existing in Iceland from the settlement to the submission to Norway
Its government by chieftains and the Althing assembly rather than by a king
zh: 冰岛自由邦又称冰岛共和国，是定居时期至臣属挪威之间存在于冰岛的政治单位
由酋长与阿尔庭议事会治理，而非由国王统治

politics.zh: 冰岛自由邦又称冰岛共和国，是9世纪定居时期至1262至1264年臣属挪威之间存在于冰岛的政治单位，由地方酋长与全体议事会阿尔庭共同治理，没有国王与中央行政。它依靠习惯法与仲裁解决争端，10世纪接受基督教，13世纪因酋长家族争斗而削弱，最终承认挪威国王的统治。
politics.en: The Icelandic Commonwealth, also known as the Icelandic Free State, was the political unit existing in Iceland between the settlement and the submission to Norway in 1262 to 1264, governed by local chieftains together with the general assembly, the Althing, without a king or central administration. It settled disputes through customary law and arbitration, adopted Christianity in the tenth century, weakened in the thirteenth amid feuds among chieftain families and finally acknowledged the king of Norway.

economy.zh: 经济以畜牧、渔业与沿海贸易为基础，牧羊与养牛是主要生计，干鱼与毛纺织品是重要出口品，木材与谷物依赖进口，海上航行连接挪威与不列颠。
economy.en: The economy rested on herding, fishing and coastal trade, with sheep and cattle the main livelihood, dried fish and woollen cloth the important exports, timber and grain imported, and sea voyages linking Iceland with Norway and Britain.

culture.zh: 自由邦时期冰岛语文学与口传传统繁荣，萨迦与埃达在此形成并被抄写，法律由诵法者口传，教会与主教区在10世纪后建立，手抄本保存了北欧神话与史学。
culture.en: In the commonwealth period Icelandic literature and oral tradition flourished, sagas and eddas taking shape and being written down there, law recited orally by the lawspeaker, the church and bishoprics established after the tenth century, and manuscripts preserving Norse myth and history.

events.zh: 关键节点包括9世纪定居与阿尔庭的建立、1000年前后接受基督教、12至13世纪的酋长争斗，以及1262至1264年臣属挪威国王。
events.en: Key moments are the settlement and the establishment of the Althing in the ninth and tenth centuries, the adoption of Christianity around 1000, the feuds of the twelfth and thirteenth centuries and the submission to the king of Norway in 1262 to 1264.

value.zh: 由阿尔庭议事会与地方酋长治理，无国王。
value.en: It was governed by the Althing and local chieftains, without a king.
It submitted to the king of Norway in 1262 to 1264.

en: The Duchy of Anhalt as a historical German duchy located between the Harz Mountains and the river Elbe
Its rule by the Ascanian house and its reorganisation in the nineteenth century
zh: 安哈尔特公国是位于哈尔茨山与易北河之间的德意志公国
由阿斯坎尼家族统治，19世纪重新整合

politics.zh: 安哈尔特公国是位于哈尔茨山与易北河之间的德意志公国，由阿斯坎尼家族统治，1806年由多个安哈尔特支系合并为公国，1815年后为德意志邦联成员。它设有等级议会，1866年后与普鲁士结盟，1871年加入德意志帝国；1918年革命后君主制被废，其地并入安哈尔特自由邦，后并入萨克森-安哈尔特州。
politics.en: The Duchy of Anhalt was a historical German duchy located between the Harz Mountains and the river Elbe and ruled by the Ascanian house; in 1806 the several Anhalt branches were merged into a duchy, which joined the German Confederation after 1815. It had its own diet, allied with Prussia after 1866 and joined the German Empire in 1871; the revolution of 1918 abolished its monarchy and its territory became the Free State of Anhalt and later part of Saxony-Anhalt.

economy.zh: 经济以易北河与萨勒河流域的农业、矿业与制糖业为基础，德绍与贝恩堡是行政与工业中心，褐煤与盐的开采、机械制造在19世纪发展。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the Elbe and Saale basins, mining and sugar refining, with Dessau and Bernburg as centres of administration and industry, and lignite and salt mining and machinery manufacturing developing in the nineteenth century.

culture.zh: 安哈尔特是宗教改革早期的重要地区，维滕贝格与德绍留下建筑与园林遗产，沃尔利茨园林被列为世界遗产，宫廷赞助音乐与教育，阿斯坎尼家族谱系见于编年史。
culture.en: Anhalt was an important region in the early Reformation, Wittenberg and Dessau leaving architectural and garden heritage, the Worlitz park listed as World Heritage, its court patronising music and education, and the genealogy of the Ascanians recorded in chronicles.

events.zh: 关键节点包括13世纪阿斯坎尼家族的领地、1806年合并为公国、1871年加入德意志帝国，以及1918年革命后成为安哈尔特自由邦。
events.en: Key moments are the Ascanian territories of the thirteenth century, the merger into a duchy in 1806, its accession to the German Empire in 1871 and its transformation into the Free State of Anhalt after the revolution of 1918.

value.en: It was ruled by the Ascanian house.
It joined the German Empire in 1871.

en: Alamannia, or Alemania, as the kingdom established and inhabited by the Alemanni
The Alemanni as a Germanic tribal confederation that had broken away from earlier groupings
zh: 阿勒曼尼亚是阿勒曼尼人建立并居住的王国
阿勒曼尼人是自更早的部落联合中分离出来的日耳曼部落联盟

politics.zh: 阿勒曼尼亚又称阿勒曼尼亚王国，是阿勒曼尼人建立并居住的王国，位于莱茵河与多瑙河上游之间，即今德国西南部、阿尔萨斯与瑞士北部。阿勒曼尼人是自更早的部落联合中分离出来的日耳曼部落联盟，3世纪起进入罗马边境地区，5世纪建立王国；496年前后被法兰克人击败，此后成为法兰克王国的公国，10世纪并入神圣罗马帝国。
politics.en: Alamannia, or Alemania, was the kingdom established and inhabited by the Alemanni, a Germanic tribal confederation that had broken away from earlier groupings, lying between the upper Rhine and Danube in what is now south-western Germany, Alsace and northern Switzerland. The Alemanni entered the Roman frontier regions from the third century and formed a kingdom in the fifth; after defeat by the Franks around 496 it became a duchy within the Frankish kingdom and in the tenth century passed into the Holy Roman Empire.

economy.zh: 经济以莱茵河与多瑙河上游的农业、畜牧与河运贸易为基础，罗马时期的葡萄种植与城镇延续，修道院参与土地开发，阿尔卑斯山口的通道带来贸易收入。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, herding and river trade on the upper Rhine and Danube, with Roman viticulture and towns continuing, monasteries taking part in land development, and the Alpine passes bringing income from trade.

culture.zh: 阿勒曼尼亚留下日耳曼与罗马文化层叠的遗产，阿勒曼尼语成为后来施瓦本方言的基础，修道院是文化与文字中心，墓葬考古显示了部落与罗马传统的融合。
culture.en: Alamannia left layers of Germanic and Roman heritage, the Alemannic dialect becoming the basis of later Swabian speech, its monasteries serving as centres of culture and writing, and burials showing the fusion of tribal and Roman traditions.

events.zh: 关键节点包括3世纪阿勒曼尼人进入边境地区、5世纪建立王国、496年前后被法兰克人击败，以及此后成为法兰克与神圣罗马帝国的公国。
events.en: Key moments are the entry of the Alemanni into the frontier regions in the third century, the formation of their kingdom in the fifth, their defeat by the Franks around 496 and their later existence as a duchy within the Frankish realm and the Holy Roman Empire.

value.zh: 由阿勒曼尼人（日耳曼部落联盟）建立。
value.en: It was established by the Alemanni, a Germanic tribal confederation.
It was defeated by the Franks around 496.

en: The Anatolian beylik of Teke as one of the frontier principalities established by Oghuz Turkish clans
Its rule along the Mediterranean coast of Anatolia around Antalya
zh: 特克贝利克是乌古斯突厥诸部建立的安纳托利亚边区公国之一
统治安纳托利亚地中海沿岸，以安塔利亚一带为中心

politics.zh: 特克贝利克是乌古斯突厥诸部建立的安纳托利亚边区公国之一，13世纪末在塞尔柱与蒙古势力衰落后兴起，统治安纳托利亚西南部地中海沿岸，以安塔利亚与科尼亚以南地区为中心。它与鲁姆苏丹国的后继政权、卡拉曼及塞浦路斯与罗得岛的基督教势力互动；14世纪末被奥斯曼帝国吞并，其地成为奥斯曼行省。
politics.en: The Anatolian beylik of Teke was one of the frontier principalities established by Oghuz Turkish clans, emerging at the end of the thirteenth century as Seljuk and Mongol power declined and ruling the Mediterranean coast of south-western Anatolia around Antalya. It interacted with the successor states of the Sultanate of Rum, with the Karamanids and with the Christian powers of Cyprus and Rhodes; in the late fourteenth century it was absorbed by the Ottomans and its lands became an Ottoman province.

economy.zh: 经济以地中海沿岸的农业、伐木、港口贸易与海盗活动为基础，安塔利亚是重要港口与造船地，木材、谷物与奴隶是主要交换物，森林资源丰富。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming along the Mediterranean coast, timber felling, port trade and raiding, with Antalya an important harbour and shipbuilding site, and timber, grain and slaves among the goods exchanged in a region rich in forests.

culture.zh: 特克贝利克赞助突厥语文学与伊斯兰建筑，清真寺、经学院与商队客栈留下遗存，土库曼游牧传统与沿海定居文化并存，苏菲道堂在社会生活中活跃。
culture.en: The beylik patronised Turkish literature and Islamic architecture, its mosques, colleges and caravanserais surviving as remains, Turkmen nomadic tradition existing alongside coastal settled culture, and Sufi lodges active in social life. Its harbours were also bases for naval raiding in the Aegean.

events.zh: 关键节点包括13世纪末公国兴起、14世纪与卡拉曼及塞浦路斯势力的互动、14世纪末被奥斯曼吞并，以及其地成为奥斯曼行省。
events.en: Key moments are the rise of the principality at the end of the thirteenth century, its dealings with the Karamanids and the Cypriot powers in the fourteenth, its absorption by the Ottomans at the end of that century and its transformation into an Ottoman province.

value.zh: 由乌古斯突厥诸部建立。
value.en: It was established by Oghuz Turkish clans.
The Ottomans annexed it in the late fourteenth century.

en: The County of Waldeck, later the Principality of Waldeck and Pyrmont, as a state of the Holy Roman Empire
Its rule by the House of Waldeck and its later place among the German states
zh: 瓦尔德克伯国后为瓦尔德克与皮尔蒙特亲王国，是神圣罗马帝国的邦国
由瓦尔德克家族统治，后成为德意志诸邦之一

politics.zh: 瓦尔德克伯国后为瓦尔德克与皮尔蒙特亲王国，是神圣罗马帝国的邦国，位于今黑森与北莱茵-威斯特法伦一带，由瓦尔德克家族统治。它在中世纪形成伯国，1712年升格为亲王国，1815年后为德意志邦联成员，1866年后与普鲁士关系密切；1918年革命后君主制被废，其地并入普鲁士黑森-拿骚省。
politics.en: The County of Waldeck, later the Principality of Waldeck and Pyrmont, was a state of the Holy Roman Empire in what is now Hesse and North Rhine-Westphalia, ruled by the House of Waldeck. It took shape as a county in the Middle Ages and was raised to a principality in 1712, joined the German Confederation after 1815 and was closely tied to Prussia after 1866; the revolution of 1918 abolished its monarchy and its territory was incorporated into the Prussian province of Hesse-Nassau.

economy.zh: 经济以山地农业、林业、矿业与温泉疗养业为基础，皮尔蒙特以矿泉闻名，铁矿与林业产品是重要收入来源，城镇规模不大但行政机构完备。
economy.en: The economy rested on hill farming, forestry, mining and spa tourism, with Pyrmont known for its mineral springs, iron ore and forest products important sources of income, and its towns small but with a complete administrative apparatus.

culture.zh: 瓦尔德克保存德意志中部的地方文化，宫殿与半木结构城镇留下建筑遗产，宫廷与教会赞助音乐与教育，民间节庆与林业传统延续至今。
culture.en: Waldeck preserved the local culture of central Germany, its palaces and half-timbered towns leaving an architectural heritage, court and church patronising music and education, and folk festivals and forestry traditions continuing today. Its counts were among the earliest patrons in the region.

events.zh: 关键节点包括中世纪伯国形成、1712年升格为亲王国、1866年后与普鲁士关系密切，以及1918年革命后并入普鲁士黑森-拿骚省。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the county in the Middle Ages, its elevation to a principality in 1712, its close ties with Prussia after 1866 and its incorporation into the Prussian province of Hesse-Nassau after the revolution of 1918.

value.en: It was raised to a principality in 1712.

value.zh: 1918年革命后并入普鲁士黑森-拿骚省。
value.en: After the revolution of 1918 it passed into the Prussian province of Hesse-Nassau.

en: The Taifa of Tortosa as a medieval Islamic taifa kingdom in the north-east of the Iberian Peninsula
Its two separate periods of existence from 1010 and in the twelfth century
zh: 托尔托萨泰法是伊比利亚半岛东北部的中世纪伊斯兰泰法王国
先后在1010年起与12世纪两次存在

politics.zh: 托尔托萨泰法是伊比利亚半岛东北部的中世纪伊斯兰泰法王国，位于埃布罗河下游，先后在1010年起与12世纪两次存在，以托尔托萨城为中心。它由地方家族统治，控制埃布罗河口的贸易与内陆农业，与萨拉戈萨、巴伦西亚等泰法及巴塞罗那伯国互动；1148年被巴塞罗那伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世征服，其地并入阿拉贡王权。
politics.en: The Taifa of Tortosa was a medieval Islamic taifa kingdom in the north-east of the Iberian Peninsula, lying on the lower Ebro and existing in two separate periods from 1010 and in the twelfth century, with Tortosa as its centre. Ruled by local families, it controlled trade at the mouth of the Ebro and the farming of the interior and interacted with the taifas of Zaragoza and Valencia and with the county of Barcelona; in 1148 it was conquered by Ramon Berenguer IV of Barcelona and its lands passed to the Crown of Aragon.

economy.zh: 经济以埃布罗河下游的灌溉农业、渔业与河海联运贸易为基础，托尔托萨是区域市场与港口，稻米、柑橘与纸张是重要产品，河运连接内陆与地中海。
economy.en: The economy rested on irrigated farming on the lower Ebro, fishing and trade linking river and sea, with Tortosa a regional market and port, rice, citrus and paper among its important products, and river transport connecting the interior with the Mediterranean.

culture.zh: 托尔托萨泰法是安达卢斯东北部的文化中心之一，阿拉伯语学术与诗歌在此流传，灌溉系统与水利法庭影响后世，城墙、浴场与桥梁留下遗存。
culture.en: The taifa was one of the cultural centres of the north-eastern Al-Andalus, Arabic scholarship and poetry circulating there, its irrigation systems and water courts influencing later practice, and its walls, bath houses and bridges surviving as remains.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1010年泰法建立、12世纪初再度独立、与巴塞罗那及阿拉贡的冲突，以及1148年被拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世征服。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the taifa in 1010, its renewed independence in the early twelfth century, its conflicts with Barcelona and Aragon and its conquest by Ramon Berenguer IV in 1148. Its lands were later reorganised into the kingdom of Valencia.

value.en: It was centred on the city of Tortosa.
It was conquered by the count of Barcelona in 1148.

en: The Kingdom of the Isles as a Norse-Gaelic kingdom comprising the Isle of Man, the Hebrides and the islands of the Clyde
Its rule by Norse-Gaelic lords and its later division between Scotland and England
zh: 马恩岛及群岛王国是诺斯-盖尔王国，领有马恩岛、赫布里底群岛与克莱德湾诸岛
由诺斯-盖尔领主统治，后分归苏格兰与英格兰

politics.zh: 马恩岛及群岛王国是诺斯-盖尔王国，领有马恩岛、赫布里底群岛与克莱德湾诸岛，由诺斯-盖尔领主统治，以马恩岛与艾莱岛为中心。它在9至13世纪控制爱尔兰海的海上通道，与挪威王权、苏格兰王国及爱尔兰诸王互动；1266年《珀斯条约》后归苏格兰，马恩岛的领有权此后长期在苏格兰与英格兰之间转移。
politics.en: The Kingdom of the Isles was a Norse-Gaelic kingdom comprising the Isle of Man, the Hebrides and the islands of the Clyde, ruled by Norse-Gaelic lords from centres on Man and Islay. Through the ninth to thirteenth centuries it controlled the sea routes of the Irish Sea and interacted with the Norwegian crown, the kingdom of Scotland and the kings of Ireland; after the treaty of Perth in 1266 it passed to Scotland, while lordship of Man long changed hands between Scotland and England.

economy.zh: 经济以海上贸易、渔业、畜牧与少量农业为基础，群岛位于爱尔兰、苏格兰与英格兰之间的航路上，船只与盖尔式战船是权力基础，牲畜与海产是主要交换物。
economy.en: The economy rested on sea trade, fishing, herding and limited farming, the islands lying on the routes between Ireland, Scotland and England, with ships and galleys the basis of power and livestock and marine produce the main goods exchanged.

culture.zh: 马恩岛及群岛王国留下诺斯与盖尔文化交融的遗产，马恩岛的十字碑与城堡是代表，盖尔语与诺斯语并用，岛上的议会廷瓦尔德延续至今，编年史记录了诸王事迹。
culture.en: The kingdom left a heritage in which Norse and Gaelic culture met, the crosses and castles of Man being its best representatives, Gaelic and Norse both in use, the island's assembly, Tynwald, continuing to this day, and chronicles recording the deeds of its kings.

events.zh: 关键节点包括9世纪诺斯-盖尔政权的形成、11至12世纪的强盛、1266年《珀斯条约》归苏格兰，以及此后马恩岛领有权的转移。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of Norse-Gaelic power in the ninth century, its strength in the eleventh and twelfth, the treaty of Perth of 1266 that transferred the isles to Scotland and the later changes in the lordship of Man.

value.zh: 领有马恩岛、赫布里底群岛与克莱德湾诸岛。
value.en: It comprised the Isle of Man, the Hebrides and the islands of the Clyde.
After the treaty of Perth in 1266 it passed to Scotland.
